hooks.name: guard-test-writes
hooks.description: Block any write under tests/ during a review. The matcher fires on the write tool; the command reads the tool event on stdin and exits non-zero when the target path is inside tests/, which blocks the write. Writes to any other path pass through.

action.command: path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.path // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$path" in tests/*|*/tests/*) echo "Blocked: writes under tests/ are not allowed during a review ($path)." >&2; exit 1;; *) exit 0;; esac
